name: Post Graduate Scholarship for University Rank Holders Scheme
benefit:
**Financial Assistance**

- Scholarship of ₹3,100 per month.
- Scholarship is provided for a maximum period of two years (full duration of the postgraduate course).
- Scholarship is disbursed through the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode.
- No additional assistance is provided towards hostel fees, medical expenses, or other incidental charges.
- Students receiving this scholarship are not debarre
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must have secured First Rank or Second Rank at the undergraduate level. 1. The applicant must have obtained a minimum of 60% marks in the undergraduate examination. 1. The applicant must have secured admission to a regular, full-time Master's Degree programme. 1. The applicant must be pursuing his/her first postgraduate degree. 1. The applicant must not be more than 30 years of age at the time of admission to the postgraduate course. 1. The applicant must study in a recognized University, Deemed University, Private University, Autonomous College, or Postgraduate College. 1. The undergraduate degree must belong to any of the following streams: - Life Sciences - Physical Sciences - Chemical Sciences - Earth Sciences - Mathematical Sciences - Social Sciences - Commerce - Languages
